Overview.Name: Sandhya Balusu
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating
Overview.Goal: Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal

Early_Morning (optional): Option 2: Plain curd (1 small bowl ~100 g)
Meal_1: Option 1: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) & fish curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) & egg curry (2 eggs) & vegetable curry
Option 3: Paneer cubes (120 g) & vegetable salad
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1/2 cup cooked ~90 g) & chicken curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (1/2 cup cooked ~90 g) & paneer curry (100 g) & vegetable curry
Option 3: Egg omelette (2 eggs) & vegetable salad

Notes_and_Tips: Start meals with eggs, paneer, chicken or fish before eating rice to naturally reduce rice portions.
Keep rice portions moderate to support blood sugar balance.
Maintain consistent meal timing to support thyroid and hormonal balance.
If cravings appear due to stress or mood changes, drink buttermilk or eat a boiled egg before taking more food.
Avoid dal and dal-based foods such as idly, dosa and vada.
